---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Stop codes:     3x DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE (0x9F): a driver failed
                   during sleep or wake
What it means:  Windows hit a fatal error and restarted.
What to do:     Use the hint for each stop code above. Update the drivers
                (graphics, Wi-Fi, chipset, storage) from the PC or
                motherboard maker's website and install all Windows
                updates. If crashes continue, run Windows Memory
                Diagnostic.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CRITICAL  Forced power-off                         1 time, last 3 Oct 10:15
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
What it means:  Someone held the power button to turn the PC off, usually
                because it had frozen.
What to do:     If the PC froze, update the drivers (graphics, Wi-Fi,
                chipset, storage) from the PC or motherboard maker's
                website and install all Windows updates. Check temperatures
                if freezes happen under load.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HIGH      App crashed                             6 times, last 7 Oct 19:40
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Details:        5x game.exe (module: d3d11.dll)
                1x notepad.exe (module: ntdll.dll)
What it means:  These programs closed unexpectedly.
What to do:     Update or reinstall the app. Crashes in a graphics module
                such as d3d11.dll or a GPU driver file often go away after
                a graphics driver update.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HIGH      Display driver stopped responding and recovered
          2 times, last 6 Oct 20:58
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Driver:         2x nvlddmkm
What it means:  The graphics driver froze and Windows restarted it. You may
                have seen the screen go black or flicker.
What to do:     Install the latest graphics driver from NVIDIA, AMD, or
                Intel. If it happens in games, check GPU temperatures and
                undo overclocking.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Services:       1x Print Spooler
What it means:  A background service crashed or stopped with an error.
What to do:     Update or reinstall the software the service belongs to.

                /scannow' from an administrator command prompt.

What it means:  An update downloaded but could not be installed.
